notes: Race and Hispanic origin in these tables are self-identified social categories. They are not genetic ancestry and must never be presented as a genetic-ancestry composition.
selection_method: Whole table requested as get=group(B02001); no variable is named, matched or numbered in advance and nothing depends on a line position. Label text is read from the release's own per-group metadata endpoint recorded in label_source_url. Consumers select cells by label.
sentinel_handling: The API returns a large negative sentinel in place of a statistic it does not publish for a cell. Values are preserved verbatim and 'published' says whether the cell carries a real statistic. A false value must not be rendered as a number.
source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey
